_zones_note: These are ClasificadosOnline's own area names and must match the site exactly. zones_include shows as a normal result; zones_review lands in the 'Por confirmar' section because the site doesn't split those areas by urbanizacion.
_promote_note: A review-zone listing mentioning any of these is treated as a full match. Add urbanizaciones and condo names as you learn which ones sit in the right blocks.
_reject_note: A review-zone listing mentioning any of these is dropped entirely.
